speaker: charlie
text: Right, onto tonight's big one. <cite index='10-2,10-3'>New South Wales has been forced into a late lineup change ahead of tonight's opening State of Origin match at Sydney Olympic Park, with Raiders five-eighth Ethan Strange making his debut for the Blues, replacing Eels playmaker Mitch Moses who's been ruled out with a calf injury</cite>. Not the preparation they wanted, but Strange has been solid all year.

speaker: alice
text: That's footy for you, injuries happen at the worst times. <cite index='10-4'>Queensland is chasing its fourth series win in five years</cite>, so they'll be confident heading into Sydney. Still reckon it'll be a beauty of a match regardless of the late change.

speaker: charlie
text: Too right. Origin always delivers regardless of who's wearing the jersey. The passion and pride these blokes play with never changes, and Strange will be pumped to get his first crack at the big stage. Should be a ripper under lights at Olympic Park tonight.
